verdict.rationale: There is no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. The closest evidence is a hybrid deployment in which the scanner, S3 storage, and all AI inference run inside the customer's AWS account, plus on-prem/self-hosted options on higher tiers. That indirectly keeps code and inference within the customer's control, but Gecko still hosts the dashboard and database, so it is only an implied safeguard. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that customer data is not used for model training, a documented training opt-out or zero-retention terms for standard cloud users, any coverage of third-party LLM provider data usage, and independent corroboration.
